title: Vision-Grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment for Scalable Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.15328v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) aims to retrieve individuals with texts in multiple languages. Despite its practical importance, it has been overlooked by existing research, which mainly focuses on English-only retrieval. The only prior attempt at multilingual TBPR suffers from (1) the absence of a large-scale, multilingual pretraining dataset and (2) a suboptimal model architecture for multilingual text encoding and cross-modal alignment, which employs a shared encoder that overlooks linguistic heterogeneity and relies on English as a pivot for cross-modal alignment, introducing English-centric bias. For this, we contribute MultiPedes, the first large-scale, pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset. It contains 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, constructed by a multilingual quality-aware data construction pipeline. translated_title: 面向可扩展多语言文本行人检索的视觉锚定语义学习与对齐
translated_abstract: 多语言基于文本的行人检索（TBPR）旨在利用多种语言的文本检索行人个体。尽管具有重要的实用价值，但现有研究主要聚焦于仅英语的检索，忽视了这一领域。此前唯一一次针对多语言TBPR的尝试存在以下问题：（1）缺乏大规模的多语言预训练数据集；（2）用于多语言文本编码和跨模态对齐的模型架构欠佳，其采用的共享编码器忽视了语言异质性，并且依赖英语作为跨模态对齐的枢轴，从而引入了以英语为中心的偏差。为此，我们贡献了MultiPedes——首个大规模、以行人为中心的多语言预训练数据集。该数据集包含涵盖四种语言的1000万图像-文本对，由多语言质量感知的数据构建流程构建而成。我们还提出了ViSeLA（视觉锚定语义学习与对齐）……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个大规模多语言行人预训练数据集MultiPedes（包含四种语言的1000万图文对），并引入视觉锚定的语义学习与对齐方法，解决了多语言文本行人检索中缺乏预训练数据和英语中心偏差的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper contributes MultiPedes, the first large-scale pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset with 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, and proposes vision-grounded semantic learning and alignment to address the lack of pretraining data and English-centric bias in multilingual text-based person retrieval.
